title: Titanium Propeller Pitch Linkage
function: Controllable pitch propeller drive hub linkage
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is used for Titanium Propeller Pitch Linkage where immunity to seawater pitting corrosion (no critical pitting temperature up to 260°C) is mandatory. Unlike super-duplex stainless steels, Ti-6Al-4V suffers no chloride stress corrosion cracking in marine environments even at elevated temperatures. Its yield strength (830 MPa) enables 40% wall thickness reduction vs 316L for equivalent pressure ratings, directly reducing subsea component mass — critical for Controllable pitch propeller drive hub linkage. This rationale is driven by controllable pitch propeller drive hub linkage and fat life requirements.
process: Ring forging radial-axial for propulsion geometry
CNC turn-bore operation at 200W fiber laser
TIG welding autogenous at 200W fiber laser
Hydrostatic pressure test at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Heavy-duty passivation 25% HNO3 45min per ASTM B600 for maximum chloride pitting resistance in seawater — tailored for controllable pitch propeller application
commonFailures: HE from over-protection below -0.85V vs Ag/AgCl - controlled by anode current density limiter circuit — critical for controllable pitch propeller performance

faq.q: What welding standards apply to Titanium Propeller Pitch Linkage for marine applications?
faq.a: Titanium Propeller Pitch Linkage is welded per AWS D1.6 (Structural Welding Code — Titanium) with shielding gas purity ≥99.995% Argon and trailing shield protection. Weld zone oxygen pickup is limited to <500 ppm to maintain ductility. For controllable pitch propeller, 100% radiographic or ultrasonic inspection of weld zones is standard per ASME Section IX requirements.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Propeller Pitch Linkage orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Propeller Pitch Linkage is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Propeller Pitch Linkage?
faq.a: Each Titanium Propeller Pitch Linkage shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for controllable pitch propeller.

sceneDescription: Titanium Propeller Pitch Linkage is a marine-grade controllable pitch propeller component designed for Controllable pitch propeller drive hub linkage. Fabricated from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V, it provides immunity to seawater corrosion, chloride stress corrosion cracking, and biofouling — eliminating the need for cathodic protection in submerged service.
